info.name: Wellness Dynamo — Seed User Data for Admin
info.description:
Feed one example client through Postman (no mobile app) so the Admin client profile has live data.

Import this collection **and** `Wellness-API.postman_environment.json`. Select **Wellness API — Local**.

**Run order (folder 0 → 9).** Tokens and IDs are saved automatically.

### Example client (matches Admin Personal Details)
- Name: Madhupriya Postman
- Email: `{{userEmail}}` (default `postman.madhupriya@example.com`)
- Phone: `+91 9000010000`
- DOB: 12 Mar 1991
- Gender: female
- Address: Flat 101, Green Meadows, Baner Road, Pune, Maharashtra 411000
- Dietary preference: vegetarian
- Wellness journey for: self
- Primary concern: Fat Loss (captured from public health-concerns)
- Password: `User@12345`

### Admin login (seeded staff)
- Email: `admin@irwellness.local`
- Password: `Admin@12345`
- Requires `npm run seed:staff-accounts -- --confirm` in Backend.

### What Admin actually shows from APIs
Live: Users list, Personal Details, paid-onboarding status, At a Glance (metrics, metabolic snapshot, prakriti, lifestyle, supplements, weight).
Still fixture/demo in Admin UI (data is still stored if you POST it): Body Analytics page, Internal Parameters page, Food page, BMS charts, Nutritions page, Health Progress page, Reflection page, Prescription, Presentable, Energy Exchange, Protocol, Gut Reset.

Open the created user at `/users/{{userId}}` (UUID). Numeric `/users/1` is mock-only.

Dev OTP: set `EXPOSE_OTP_IN_RESPONSE=true` so Send OTP responses include `debugOtp`.

item.name: 0. Health
item.description: Confirm the API is running before seeding.

request.description: Expected `{ ok: true }`.

item.name: 1. Catalog lookups (no auth)
item.description: Capture IDs used later. Run Health Concerns and Supplements before register / dosage.

request.description: Saves `healthConcernId`. Prefers a concern titled Fat Loss (Admin example goal).
Saves `supplementId` for staff dosage assignment (At a Glance supplements).
Example: admin@irwellness.local / Admin@12345 after staff seed.
Saves `coachId` (first coach, prefers Anita).
Same endpoint Admin Users page calls.

item.name: 3. Register example user
item.description: Creates a SEEK client. `primaryHealthConcern` is required. OTP is sent to WhatsApp/phone.

request.description: Must use the same email + WhatsApp delivery number as Register. OTP is keyed by WhatsApp phone when whatsappSameAsMobile is false. In local/dev with EXPOSE_OTP_IN_RESPONSE=true, `debugOtp` is auto-saved to `userOtp`.

exec: if (!json.debugOtp) console.warn('No debugOtp — set EXPOSE_OTP_IN_RESPONSE=true or paste OTP into userOtp');

request.description: Register fields stored on User. Address / diet / journey are filled in paid-onboarding profile next. Gender values: male, female, other, boy, girl, guess.
Use if the user already exists.
Confirms tokens. Saves `userId`.

item.name: 4. Convert to Heal + assign coach
item.description: Heal tier is required for onboarding, meals, reflection, metabolic, health-progress. Assign a WC so meal logs and dosages have a coach hierarchy.

request.description: Optional `referralCode` / `catalogProgramId`. After this, Admin list shows HEAL (Seek to Heal).
`assignedCoachType`: wellness_coach | assistant_wellness_coach. For AWC also send parentCoachId.
User POSTs to /user/health-progress/* are blocked until these flags are on. menstrualCycle only sticks for female users.
Enables At a Glance meditation / pranayam / exercise from DRF logs.

item.name: 5. Paid onboarding (fills Personal Details + onboarding grid)
item.description: Maps to Admin paid-onboarding keys: personalDetails, profileSetup, bodyMeasurement, progressPhotos180, medicalConditions, internalParameter, launch.

request.description: dietaryPreference: vegetarian | eggetarian | vegan | non_vegetarian | jain. wellnessJourneyFor is an array of strings. Marks personalDetails + profileSetup done.
Feeds At a Glance metabolic snapshot (height/weight). activityLevel: sedentary | lightly_active | moderately_active | highly_active. Optional multipart field `weight_pic`.
Skippable steps: bodyMeasurement, progressPhotos180, medicalConditions.
Use instead of skip if you have 3 photos. Field names: front_pic, right_pic, left_pic.
Builds `medicalAnswersJson` for the next request.

exec: if (type === 'yes_no') return { questionId: q.id, answer: false };
if (type === 'yes_no_text') return { questionId: q.id, answer: true, details: 'No current medication' };
return { questionId: q.id, text: 'No known issues' };

request.description: Must include every active question. yes_no uses `answer` boolean; yes_no_text needs `details` when true; text uses `text`; date uses `date`.
Marks paidOnboardingStepStatus.internalParameter = done. Field name: file (PDF only).
Marks launch done. Lifestyle score still needs a staff LAUNCH assessment (folder 8).

item.name: 6. Daily tracking (At a Glance metrics)
item.description: Water, steps, meals, daily reflection. Admin At a Glance reads the last ~5 days.

request.description: Example: 6 / 8 glasses (Admin water card).
Example: 9,400 / 10,000 (Admin steps card).
category: functional_juice | salad | meal | beverage | snacks | protein. Requires Heal + assigned coach. User logs get dummy macros server-side; still send example macros.
`honestConfirmed` must be true. Values are minutes/cycles per activity. Example matches Admin cards: meditation 15 min, pranayam 6 min, exercise 45 min.

item.name: 7. Metabolic + health progress
item.description: Body analytics snapshot + weight card on At a Glance. Health-progress POSTs need folder 4 settings first.

request.description: activityLevel: sedentary | lightly_active | moderately_active | highly_active | very_active | extra_active
Female users must send hipCm (US Navy method).
Optional multipart `weight_pic`. Feeds At a Glance healthProgressPrograms.
type: fbs | ppbs
Only for female users with menstrualCycle feature enabled.

item.name: 8. Staff data Admin At a Glance also reads
item.description: LAUNCH lifestyle score, prakriti label, and supplement cards are written by staff APIs, not the mobile user.

request.description: totalScore 0–750. 540 → lifestyle ~7.2 / 10 (Admin example).
prakrutiType: vata | pitta | kapha | vata_pitta | pitta_kapha | kapha_vata | sama_prakriti. Admin example: Vata.
Each period needs period (morning|afternoon|evening), quantity > 0, mealRelation (before|after). Requires an active catalog supplement.

item.name: 9. Verify in Admin
item.description: These are the reads Admin uses. After this, open Admin → Users → the UUID profile.

request.description: Admin profile shell + Personal Details.
Live glance: metabolicSnapshot, dailyMetrics (protein/water/steps/meditation/pranayam/exercise), supplements, lifestyleScore, prakriti, dailyScore, healthProgressPrograms.

item.name: 10. Extra user writes (optional)
item.description: Stored in DynamoDB. New Admin section pages mostly still show fixtures, but these APIs work without the mobile app.

request.description: time HH:mm. days: 0=Sun … 6=Sat. Admin reminders UI is still local.
